bullets.text: Pornhub Utilises Apple Verification - **Pornhub** adopts **Apple's** age verification for UK users, complying with new regulations.
Apple TV 4K Gets AI Upgrade - New **Apple TV 4K** may feature AI enhancements inspired by **Netflix's** voice search.
CarPlay Allows Video Playback - **iOS 26** introduces video playback on **CarPlay**, but only when parked.
PS5 Sales Decline Significantly - **Sony** reports a 46% drop in **PS5** sales due to price increases and economic pressures.
Nintendo Switch 2 Price Hike - **Nintendo** raises **Switch 2** prices globally, forecasting a sales drop.
OpenAI Launches Voice Features - **OpenAI** introduces new voice intelligence capabilities in its API for developers.
Gusto Hits $1B Revenue - **Gusto** surpasses $1 billion in revenue, positioning itself closer to public markets.
Elon Musk's Lawsuit Against OpenAI - **Musk's** lawsuit scrutinizes **OpenAI's** safety practices amid ongoing court battles.
Disney Plans Unified Super App - **Disney** executives discuss merging **Disney+** with other apps into a single platform.
Bumble Ditches Swiping Feature - **Bumble** CEO announces the removal of swiping, aiming for a revolutionary app redesign.
